name: Ragdoll
description: Inhabits full-body motor augments and occasionally causes complete momentary loss of muscle tone — the user goes limp for 0.5-1 second, then recovers.
observed_behavior: Inhibits all motor signals simultaneously for a brief pulse. The effect resembles a micro-seizure but EEG shows no neurological abnormality.
story_hooks: Ragdoll triggers during a fight and the user drops — the bullet passes through the space their head occupied 0.3 seconds ago
